tokens.name: Surface hierarchy

value.expression: cards are lighter than the canvas and separated with subtle borders rather than strong shadow

claim.statement: The interface uses low-contrast nested surfaces to establish containment.

confidence.basis: The relationship repeats across navigation, summary cards, charts, and table rows.

exceptions: The primary action uses a saturated blue fill

validation.method: Compare generated surfaces against reference screenshots at matched scale.

tokens.role: Separate canvas, navigation, cards, charts, and rows through restrained semantic surface tiers.

tokens.name: Repeated spacing rhythm

value.expression: internal card padding is smaller than the gaps between major dashboard sections

claim.statement: Spacing establishes nested hierarchy through repeated relative intervals.

confidence.basis: The same relative rhythm appears across multiple containers, but source scale prevents exact measurement.

validation.method: Measure representative screenshot intervals and test candidate token ratios.

tokens.role: Express repeated internal, peer, group, section, and page spacing relationships.

tokens.name: Metric typography hierarchy
tokens.role: Separate metric label, primary value, unit, comparison, and timeframe.

value.expression: primary values dominate labels; units and comparisons remain legible but subordinate; comparable values align consistently

relationships.expression: value-to-context spacing is tighter than spacing between independent metrics

claim.statement: Metrics use a stable label-value-context hierarchy that supports rapid comparison.

confidence.basis: The hierarchy repeats across summary cards, compact metrics, and the chart header.

validation.method: Compare the generated role relationship against matched reference regions and the routed matrix stress cases.

tokens.name: Chart series separation

validation.method: Compare the generated role relationship against matched reference regions and the routed matrix stress cases.

rules.name: Stable card anatomy
requirements: Keep header identity separate from the primary value area
Reserve trailing actions without shifting the value
validationCases: Card with no action
Card with a long title
Card with two lines of supporting text

claim.statement: Analytic cards repeat a recognizable header and value anatomy.

confidence.basis: The pattern repeats across summary and performance sections.

exceptions: Large chart cards add legends and axes

validation.method: Render all card variants together and compare anatomy alignment.

rules.rationale: Analytic cards repeat a recognizable header and value anatomy.
failureModes: The generated pattern loses hierarchy, legibility, state meaning, or action access under declared stress cases.

rules.name: Resilient content overflow
requirements: Allow descriptive text to wrap or clamp without hiding adjacent actions
Expose full meaningful values through an accessible detail mechanism
Never let unbroken content expand the page unexpectedly
validationCases: Two-hundred-character description
Unbroken identifier
Localized label expanded by one hundred percent
Text enlarged to two hundred percent

claim.statement: Components should preserve hierarchy and action access under long or unbroken content; this behavior is proposed because the screenshots show only short examples.

confidence.basis: The rule is necessary for robust implementation but is not visible in the source.

exceptions: Identifiers whose full value is required may use a scrollable or copyable region

validation.method: Run content expansion, unbroken-string, localization, and text-zoom stress tests.

rules.rationale: Components should preserve hierarchy and action access under long or unbroken content; this behavior is proposed because the screenshots show only short examples.
failureModes: The generated pattern loses hierarchy, legibility, state meaning, or action access under declared stress cases.

rules.name: Explicit business states
requirements: Define loading, empty, no-results, partial, error, warning, success, stale, and disabled behavior as applicable
Preserve card geometry when state content changes
Pair blocking failures with an actionable recovery path
validationCases: Near-instant load
Slow load
One widget fails
All data fails
No matching campaign

claim.statement: Missing business states should preserve the visible component anatomy; these states are proposed because no alternate state is shown.

confidence.basis: The screenshots establish stable containers, while robust state behavior remains absent.

validation.method: Render every applicable state and compare geometry, message actionability, and recovery.

rules.rationale: Missing business states should preserve the visible component anatomy; these states are proposed because no alternate state is shown.
failureModes: The generated pattern loses hierarchy, legibility, state meaning, or action access under declared stress cases.

rules.name: Priority-preserving reflow
requirements: Keep the page title and primary action discoverable
Stack summary cards before compressing their content
Give wide data regions a deliberate scroll, collapse, or alternative representation
validationCases: Three-hundred-twenty-pixel viewport
Four-hundred-percent zoom
Long localized labels
Wide table

claim.statement: The dashboard should reflow by semantic priority; this is proposed because both screenshots show a large desktop layout.

confidence.basis: The visual hierarchy establishes priority, but no narrow viewport is supplied.

exceptions: Dense data regions may use bounded horizontal scrolling when equivalent content remains accessible

validation.method: Run viewport and zoom tests while checking order, access, and overflow.

rules.rationale: The dashboard should reflow by semantic priority; this is proposed because both screenshots show a large desktop layout.
failureModes: The generated pattern loses hierarchy, legibility, state meaning, or action access under declared stress cases.

rules.name: KPI decision context
rules.rationale: A value without unit, comparison, timeframe, target, or freshness can look precise while remaining ambiguous.
requirements: Expose metric label and primary value
Show applicable unit, timeframe, comparison, target, qualifier, and freshness
Keep beneficial, adverse, neutral, missing, and stale meaning independent from color alone
failureModes: The value or delta cannot be interpreted without hidden business knowledge
Color or arrow direction is the only desirability cue
validationCases: zero, negative, very large, missing, stale, and ambiguous-trend values

claim.statement: Statistics preserve label, value, context, and comparison as distinct but connected roles.

confidence.basis: Repeated metrics show stable label, value, context, and comparison positions.

validation.method: Compare the generated role relationship against matched reference regions and the routed matrix stress cases.

rules.name: Chart encoding and context
rules.rationale: A reusable chart needs a question, comparison, encoding, scale context, and accessible alternative, not only visual styling.
requirements: Preserve title, summary, series identity, axes, scale context, labels, legend, and references as applicable
Keep primary data marks more salient than supporting grid and axes
Provide a proposed text summary and data alternative until implemented accessibility is verified
failureModes: Series cannot be distinguished or compared
Baseline, period, units, legend, or non-color meaning is missing
validationCases: many series, missing values, narrow width, enlarged text, and color-vision simulation

claim.statement: Chart hierarchy keeps the comparison legible while supporting context remains available.

confidence.basis: The revenue chart visibly combines a dominant plot with title, summary, axes, labels, and legend.

validation.method: Compare the generated role relationship against matched reference regions and the routed matrix stress cases.

compositionRules: The component owns internal spacing; its parent owns spacing between peers.
